team.abilityDesc: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.

moves.name: Frost Breath
moves.desc: The user attacks by blowing its cold breath on the target. This move always lands a critical hit.

moves.name: Rest
moves.desc: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.desc: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.

moves.name: Slash
moves.desc: The target is attacked with a slash of claws, scythes, or the like. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

team.abilityDesc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.desc: This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.

moves.name: Icicle Spear
moves.desc: The user attacks by launching sharp icicles at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Mirror Shot
moves.desc: The user lets loose a flash of energy at the target from its polished body. This may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.desc: The user attacks the target by jumping out and startling the opponent. This attack hits first and makes the target flinch, but it works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.
